summary.intent: Resolve PR review comments, refactor the api-client from a module-level singleton to instance-scoped axios so multiple CipherBoxClient instances can operate independently, investigate a throttle bypass gap in load tests, and rename test directories for naming consistency.
summary.outcome: All PR review threads were resolved across multiple rounds; the singleton was fully eliminated with a single shared axios instance (created in api-config.ts, passed to both the generated function path and CipherBoxClient); the throttle bypass gap was confirmed fixed as a side-effect of the refactor; test directories were renamed to web-e2e/sdk-e2e/desktop-e2e; and a branch protection regression from a job rename was identified and fixed.

repo: The api-client package uses a module-level singleton (setApiClientConfig / customInstance) that all generated orval functions share — this was the root cause of switchTo() hacks in tests and cross-suite contamination.

Phase 19.1 (Extract core SDK) was marked as 6/6 plans complete in ROADMAP.md but checkboxes were unchecked; the web app rewiring (Plan 19.1-05) was only partially done — folder/file/bin ops used CipherBoxClient but 13 files still imported directly from @cipherbox/api-client.

BypassableThrottlerGuard.canActivate() returns true before super.canActivate(), so per-endpoint @Throttle decorators are always bypassed when the bypass header is present — this is intentional and correct.
The IPFS controller only has JwtAuthGuard (no throttle), so IPFS calls were never rate-limited; the 429s in load tests were caused by IPNS calls going through bare axios without the bypass header.

sdk-core/src/ipfs/index.ts used bare axios.post() with manual token injection instead of the instance-scoped axios — this bypassed 401 refresh and, before the refactor, also bypassed the throttle bypass header.

Branch protection rules reference GitHub Actions check names by exact string (e.g., 'Release Gate / Verify E2E Passed'); renaming a job in release-gate.yml creates a new check name that doesn't match the required check, blocking all PRs from merging.
The release-gate.yml workflow is only meant to gate release-please PRs but a job rename caused the Verify E2E Passed check to appear as a required check on normal PRs too.
The tests/e2e-desktop/ directory contained only shell scripts with no package.json, not a pnpm workspace package.

code.finding: customInstance was rewritten to accept an optional _axiosInstance in its options parameter, bypassing the singleton when provided. createAxiosInstance now handles 401 refresh logic that was previously duplicated in getCachedInstance.
SdkContext gained an optional axiosInstance field (typed as AxiosInstance imported from @cipherbox/api-client re-export, not directly from axios since axios is not a direct dependency of sdk-core).

CipherBoxClient constructor now creates its own axios instance via createAxiosInstance() and stores it in ctx.axiosInstance. Accepts optional axiosInstance in CipherBoxClientConfig to allow sharing an externally-created instance.

api-config.ts now creates the single shared axios instance (with auth + 401 refresh) and passes it to both setApiClientConfig (for generated function path) and exports it for CipherBoxClient consumption via sdk-provider.ts.
Guard had 37.5% patch coverage with no dedicated spec file. All code paths now covered by throttler-bypass.guard.spec.ts with 100% statement/branch/function/line coverage.

addToIpfs and unpinFromIpfs were using bare axios.post() with manual Authorization header construction. Migrated to ctx.axiosInstance for consistency, 401 refresh support, and throttle bypass header propagation.

switchTo() method was removed entirely from MultiAccountFixture — it was only needed to reconfigure the singleton between account operations. All callers in share-operations.test.ts and invite-link.test.ts had switchTo() calls removed.
Job display name must remain 'Verify E2E Passed' to match branch protection rule. Renaming it creates a new check name that breaks required status checks on all PRs.

workflow: When renaming GitHub Actions jobs, always check if the job name is referenced in branch protection required status checks — the check name is 'Workflow Name / Job Name' and must match exactly.

Rate limit 429s during pnpm test (running all packages in parallel) are a test infrastructure issue from parallel suites hitting the live API simultaneously, not code bugs — run packages in isolation to verify.

The orval-generated functions in api-client can accept an optional axios instance via the options parameter without requiring orval config regeneration — this enables instance-scoped calls without breaking existing callers.

When threading an optional context parameter through a call chain, backward compatibility is free if the parameter is optional — existing callers without ctx fall through to the singleton path automatically.
Historical planning docs (.planning/) should be left unchanged when renaming — they are point-in-time records and updating them provides no value.

friction: The sdk package's types.ts initially tried to import AxiosInstance directly from 'axios' via dynamic import, which failed because axios is not a direct dependency of the sdk package — had to use the re-export from @cipherbox/api-client instead.

sdk-core unit tests for ipns.test.ts failed after the refactor because mock assertions expected the old single-argument call signature; the assertions needed updating to expect two arguments (data + undefined options).

Coverage collection for the throttler guard didn't work when invoked via CLI — jest.spyOn on the parent class prototype prevented instrumentation of the guard module; coverage only collects correctly when run via the jest config's collectCoverageFrom.
The ci/load test 429 errors during parallel test runs were misleading — they appeared to be code failures but were actually rate limit hits from concurrent test suites all using the live API.

The rename from tests/e2e to tests/ui-e2e required a second rename to tests/web-e2e for naming consistency with sdk-e2e, and the job display name in release-gate.yml had to be reverted after it caused a branch protection regression.
open_items: 13 web app files still import directly from @cipherbox/api-client (auth, vault init, shares, invites, device approval, health checks, IPFS, IPNS hooks) — these are not yet routed through CipherBoxClient. Full elimination of direct imports would complete the Phase 19.1-05 rewiring.
fetchFromIpfs in sdk-core/ipfs/index.ts still uses native fetch() for streaming — intentionally not migrated to axios instance since streaming download doesn't benefit from axios interceptors.
The .planning/ historical docs still reference tests/e2e (old path) — left intentionally as point-in-time records but could be confusing if someone searches for the current path.
Consider adding a parallel test execution strategy or test API accounts to avoid 429 collisions when running pnpm test across all packages simultaneously.
ROADMAP.md Phase 19.1 checkboxes are unchecked despite the work being done — the roadmap tracking state may be stale.
